title: Glungezerbahn Tulfes
name: Glungezerbahn Tulfes
kurzbeschreibung: The modern 10-seater gondola lift up the Glungezer near Tulfes: panoramic mountain in the Tuxer Alpen, Kugelwald am Glungezer, and starting point of the Zirbenweg.
beschreibung:
Overview

The Glungezerbahn in the picturesque holiday village of Tulfes in the Tyrolean Inntal provides access to the popular panoramic and adventure mountain Glungezer in the Tuxer Voralpen. Located just a few minutes by car from the provincial capital Innsbruck and the historic salt-mining town of Hall in Tirol, the modern 10-seater gondola lift carries guests from around 920 metres above sea level up to the Halsmarter middle station at 1,560 metres and onwards to the Tulfeinjöchl at over 2,050 metres. With spectacular panoramic views of the rugged limestone cliffs of the Nordkette and the wide Inntal, the Glungezer is a year-round natural paradise for families, leisure hikers, and mountaineers.

Route & Requirements

The traditional cable car history on the Glungezer began as early as the mid-20th century as a beloved local mountain. Between 2018 and 2020, the entire lift infrastructure was comprehensively modernized: the state-of-the-art, barrier-free 10-seater monocable gondola replaced the old chairlifts and tow lifts, offering premium ride comfort with panoramic glazing ever since. At the Halsmarter middle station, the Kugelwald am Glungezer awaits as the world's largest wooden ball track in the wild: across more than 7,000 square metres of pristine stone pine and spruce forest, solid stone pine balls roll along spectacular wooden tracks, steep curves, and sound trees. For hikers, the Tulfeinjöchl mountain station provides the ideal starting point for the world-famous Zirbenweg, which runs at over 2,000 metres above sea level through one of Europe's oldest and largest contiguous stone pine forests towards the Patscherkofel.

Visit & Arrival

The Glungezerbahn operates daily from 08:30 to 16:30 during the summer season from late May to late October as well as in the winter season. Summer lift fares (season 2025/2026): round trip adults approx. €28.50, seniors approx. €25.50, children (born 2010–2018) approx. €16.50; young children ride free of charge. Access to the Kugelwald at the middle station is free with a cable car ticket. Holders of the regional guest card or the Innsbruck Card receive discounts or free travel. Public transport: take ÖBB regional trains to Hall in Tirol or Innsbruck Hauptbahnhof; from there, VVT bus line 4134 runs regularly directly to the valley station (stop Tulfes Glungezerbahn). By car: via the Inntalautobahn A12, exit Hall Mitte, continuing uphill on the regional road to Tulfes; free parking is available at the valley station.

Tips

The 10-seater gondola lift, boarding and disembarking, and the stations are completely barrier-free and stroller-accessible; the trail around the Kugelwald can also be navigated with all-terrain strollers. Stop by the rustic Alpengasthaus Halsmarter at the middle station and savour Tyrolean Speckknödel and homemade Kaiserschmarrn on the sun terrace overlooking the Karwendel.
